_comment: Pins the real-design corpus that lib/corpus/sweep.test.ts runs against.
The corpus is other people's design files under their own terms and is never committed here;
it lives in a separate private repository and is fetched by scripts/fetch-fixtures.mjs.
'commit' is an immutable pin — a tag or branch could move under us and silently change what
the suite asserts. 'checksums' is the sha256 of that snapshot's own CHECKSUMS.sha256, which in
turn hashes every design file: verifying the manifest and then verifying each file against it
makes the whole corpus tamper-evident without depending on the archive being byte-reproducible
To re-cut: push the new corpus to the fixtures repo, then update 'commit' and 'checksums' here
and re-run `npm run fetch-fixtures` to confirm the sweep still passes.
